identity.name: Aquaracer Professional 300 Date
identity.one_liner: TAG Heuer's 2021-redesigned 300m dive watch, offered in steel with a ceramic bezel and the Calibre 5 automatic movement.

narrative.story: TAG Heuer's Aquaracer line dates to 2004, building on the earlier Heuer Series 2000 dive watches of the 1980s. The range was fully redesigned in 2021 with a new case and the Calibre 5 automatic movement across the Professional 300 lineup. The WBP201 family covers the 43mm steel model in blue and black-ceramic-bezel colorways.
narrative.collector_notes: Individual colorways within this reference family have been discontinued at different times — TAG Heuer's own site lists the blue steel and blue-bezel steel variants as discontinued while the black-DLC variant remained active — so confirm the full reference suffix before assuming current availability or price.
